source: RPSC official School Lecturer (School Education) Chemistry Paper-II syllabus PDF

units.name: Atomic Structure
units.details: Fundamental particles; modern atomic structure; quantum numbers; Aufbau principle; Pauli exclusion principle; Hund’s rule; electronic configuration; classification and periodicity; s, p, d and f block elements.

units.name: p-Block Elements
units.details: General introduction; electronic configuration; occurrence; oxidation states; compounds of p-block elements; trends in physical and chemical properties.

units.name: Transition Elements; Lanthanides and Actinides
units.details: Transition elements; electronic configuration; oxidation states; absorption and charge-transfer spectra; magnetic properties; compounds; Werner theory; IUPAC nomenclature; isomerism; colour and stability of coordination compounds; lanthanides and actinides; ionic sizes; reactivity; applications of d- and f-block elements.

units.name: Solid State and Surface Chemistry
units.details: Classification of solids; unit-cell density calculations; packing; point defects; electrical and magnetic properties; physical and chemical adsorption; catalysis; colloids and emulsions.

units.name: Solutions
units.details: Types of solutions; solubility and concentration; vapour pressure; ideal and non-ideal solutions; colligative properties; molar-mass calculations; abnormal molecular mass; van’t Hoff factor.

units.name: Thermodynamics
units.details: Thermodynamic terms; zeroth, first and second laws and applications; work and heat; spontaneity; Gibbs energy change and equilibrium.

units.name: Alkanes, Alkenes, Alkynes and Haloalkanes
units.details: Methods of preparation and chemical reactions of alkanes, alkenes, alkynes and haloalkanes.

units.name: Alcohols, Aldehydes, Ketones, Carboxylic Acids and Derivatives
units.details: Classification; nomenclature; preparation; physical properties; chemical reactions of alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids and derivatives.

units.name: Halo, Nitro, Amino-Arenes and Diazonium Salts
units.details: Preparations and chemical properties of halo, nitro and amino-arenes; diazonium salts and their synthetic applications.

units.name: Biomolecules
units.details: Carbohydrates; proteins; enzymes; vitamins; nucleic acids.

units.name: Chemical Bonding
units.details: Theories of chemical bonding; valence-bond and molecular-orbital theories of diatomic molecules; VSEPR theory; hydrogen bonding; quantum mechanics; Schrödinger wave equation for one-electron systems.

units.name: Coordination Complexes
units.details: Crystal-field theory for weak- and strong-field complexes; comparison of VB and CFT; factors affecting 10 Dq; thermodynamic aspects; Jahn–Teller effect; importance and applications.

units.name: Chemistry of Lanthanides and Actinides
units.details: Lanthanide and actinide contraction and consequences; coordination behaviour; magnetic and spectroscopic properties; separation of lanthanides.

units.name: Chemical Dynamics
units.details: Rate and factors affecting reactions; zero-, first-, pseudo-first- and second-order reactions; half-life; order determination; collision and transition-state theories; Arrhenius equation; activation energy.

units.name: Electrochemistry
units.details: Conductance; equivalent and molar conductivity; dilution effects; electrodes; SHE; electrochemical and galvanic cells; strong-electrolyte theory; Debye–Hückel theory; Nernst equation; ionic equilibria; fuel and concentration cells; corrosion.

units.name: Enthalpy and Entropy
units.details: Enthalpy changes; reaction enthalpies; entropy as a function of temperature and volume; Hess’s law; Gibbs and Helmholtz functions.

units.name: Stereochemistry of Organic Compounds
units.details: Chirality; optical activity; geometrical and optical isomerism; enantiomers; diastereomers; meso compounds; R/S and E/Z nomenclature; resolution; inversion; retention; racemisation; conformations of ethane, butane and cyclohexane.

units.name: Reaction Intermediates and Name Reactions
units.details: Free radicals; carbocations; carbanions; carbenes; benzyne; nitrene; mechanisms of Aldol, Cannizzaro, Perkin, Stobbe, Benzoin, Reformatsky, Knoevenagel, Baeyer–Villiger, Wittig and Mannich reactions.

units.name: Aromaticity and Arenes
units.details: Aromaticity; nomenclature and isomerism; benzene and alkyl-arenes; structure and properties; electrophilic substitution; directing effects; pyridine, pyrrole, furan and thiophene.

units.name: Polymers and Drugs
units.details: Polymers; types and mechanisms of polymerisation; natural and synthetic polymers; antacids; antihistamines; analgesics; antipyretics; antibiotics; antifertility drugs.

units.name: Molecular Orbital Theory
units.details: Symmetry elements and operations; point groups; Mulliken symbols; group theory and character tables; MO theory of heteronuclear diatomic and polyatomic molecules (AX2, AX3, AX4).

units.name: Organometallic Compounds
units.details: Organometallic compounds of Li, Mg, Sn, Fe, Cu and Zn; structure, bonding and applications; metal carbonyls; cage and cluster compounds; organometallic reagents in catalysis and organic synthesis.

units.name: Kinetics and Catalysis
units.details: Photochemical and polymerisation kinetics; acid-base and enzyme catalysis; ionic reactions; kinetic salt effect; complex reactions.

units.name: Electrochemistry
units.details: EMF measurement; Kohlrausch’s law and applications; membrane equilibria; calculation of ΔH, ΔG, ΔS and equilibrium constant from EMF data.

units.name: Thermodynamics
units.details: Third law; Joule–Thomson experiment; Maxwell relations and applications; Gibbs–Duhem equation; fugacity and activity.

units.name: Substitution and Elimination Reactions
units.details: SN1, SN2, SNi, E1 and E2 reactions of haloalkanes; preparation and chemical reactions of phenols, ethers and epoxides.

units.name: Pericyclic Reactions
units.details: Electrocyclic, cycloaddition and sigmatropic rearrangements; photo-organic chemistry of alkenes and carbonyl compounds.

units.name: Environmental Pollution
units.details: Air, water and soil pollution; heavy metals; photochemical smog; acid rain; ozone depletion; greenhouse effect; global warming; green chemistry principles.

units.name: Spectroscopy
units.details: Elementary principles of IR, UV, NMR, Raman, ESR and mass spectrometry; structure elucidation of organic compounds.

units.name: Pedagogy and Teaching Learning Material
units.details: Instructional strategies for adolescent learners; verbal and non-verbal classroom communication; advance organiser, inquiry training, group investigation and non-directive teaching models; preparation and use of teaching-learning material; cooperative learning.

units.name: Use of Computers and ICT in Teaching-Learning
units.details: ICT and digital learning; e-learning and virtual classrooms; technology integration in teaching-learning and assessment.

subjects.name: RPSC Paper I · General Awareness & General Studies
subjects.subtitle: Common Paper I · 150 Marks

units.name: Rajasthan and Indian History
units.details: History of Rajasthan and Indian history with special emphasis on the Indian National Movement.

units.name: Mental Ability, Statistics, Mathematics and Languages
units.details: Mental ability; secondary-level statistics and mathematics; Hindi and English language ability.

units.name: Current Affairs
units.details: Current affairs relevant to the examination; maintain dated notes and verify facts from reliable sources.

units.name: General Science, Indian Polity and Rajasthan Geography
units.details: General science; Indian polity; geography of Rajasthan.

units.name: Educational Management and Rajasthan Education Scenario
units.details: Educational management; educational scenario in Rajasthan; Right to Education Act, 2009.
